B.name: Tahath
B.line: Kohathite Levite, son of Assir, father of Zephaniah (Heman's ancestry); possibly same as bearer 1

why: The Hebrew genealogy links Zephaniah in verse 36 to Tahath in verse 37, then continues through Assir, Ebiasaph, and Korah. B explicitly identifies Tahath as Zephaniah’s father in Heman’s ancestry, matching this sequence.
